paragraphs: I’m drawn to architecture problems: hard ones that need a well-thought-out design, solved in a way that is creative but still practical in production.

I start from analysis, understanding a system before changing it. Design decisions are my own; AI tools help me take them to production. And I document with the precision other engineers need to pick the work up.
Right now I’m looking for my first role in systems administration, and studying Kubernetes towards the CKA.
